```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Calculate top 10 dog breeds by count
breed_counts = df.groupby('Rasse1Text')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10)

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
sns.set_style('whitegrid')
sns.barplot(x=breed_counts.values, y=breed_counts.index, palette='viridis', orient='h')

plt.xlabel('Number of Dogs Registered', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Dog Breed', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Top 10 Most Common Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontsize=14, pad=20)
plt.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=10)
plt.tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=10)
plt.grid(axis='x', linestyle='--', alpha=0
